THE IDEA

Project overview.

A personalized food recommendation concept combining content-based and collaborative filtering with reinforcement learning. The goal is to explore healthier, more suitable meal options based on preferences and nutrition data.

Areas of exploration

  • Hybrid recommendation approach
  • Reinforcement learning exploration: DQN, PPO, A2C
  • Nutrition-based filtering
  • Explainable AI with SHAP / LIME
  • Wearable data integration — planned

The detailed case study is being prepared. More about the process and results will be added here.
